content: Jesus Aetonalikiheta Maetonanehare
Hatyo najikinita judeunai hisehare tyaohena Jerusalém nali hoka Jesus xane waiya.

Hatyo nali one nitini kalorexe, 5-hati taose kakoare wahaharexe tehitiya hatyo one haliya. Wenakalati Kalanero Xisoakala aokahitere nali maniya hatyo one nitini kalorexe. Judeunai xako atyo, “Betesda”, nexahitaha hatyo one nitini xaokaka.
Kahare hokakitinai hatyo hati taosenae ako etolijoita one haliya, maxoseharenai, mawaiyehalitinai, maetonaneharenai hare. Tyaonahitaha atyahahitaha one watyalisaka xahita.
Haiya xowaka anjo exoita hoka one watyalita. Hatyo najikinita xala hotohare xamani exoa exaiya hoka kinatereheta.
Exowakita hatya haliti hatyo nali etolijoita, 38-terehokoanehena hokakita.
Owene etolijoita hoka Jesus waiyene hoka otita wahehena ehokakene hoka nexa ihiye: — Xoana hikinatereheta haokowita? nexa ihiye.
Hoka nehena Jesus hiye: — Xekohaseti, maisa xala hare mokare natyo onexa, one kawatyalisakehena hoka. Nexoa xakore naokowita exaiya hoka nahitita hatya hokakiti exoita exaiya — nexa.
Hatyaoseta Jesus nexa ihiye: — Hatityoahetehena hoka hiyetolisoakala hiyehetehena hoka hatohetehena — nexa.
Nexa taita ihiye hoka exowakita hatyo haliti kinatereheta rotita, iyeheta haxetolisoakala, xaneheta. Sábado xowaka aetonakihetene.

Hiyeta hoka judeunai nityohalitiranai nexaha ihiye: — Kalikini sábado, mahateniti ferakene. Mahateniti ferakene hoka awa atyo hakolatya hiyetolisoakala. Wiyaotyakisakaho hiyeta hoka maisa waiyeta — nexaha ihiye.
Hoka nehena ihiyeha: — Xasemehena, noxajiyakisase atyo nexa nohiye: “Hiyehetehena hiyetolisoakala hoka hatohetehena”, nexa nohiye.
— Xala nikare irae hikakoa hoka nikare hisaona? nexa axahene.
Hoka maisa atyo Jesus nexare semita. Jesus atyo koxaka xaneheta hatyo nalita, kahare haliti tyaonita hatyo akiti hoka. — Maisa nasemita noxajiyakisase nexare — nexa ihiyeha.

Wahasehena hoka Jesus tyoa isoahitiya Iraexatyakalati Hanako hoka ahalakoatya hatyo haxajiyakirahare hoka nehena ihiye: — Hasemehena, kalikini atyo hawaiyeheta. Awa atyo iniyalahare hisomehitiya, waiya aliya hoka exahehena hisaonita — nexa ihiye.
Nexa Jesus ihiye hoka hatyaoseta hikoaheta hoka xakaini judeunai nityohalitiranai hiye: — Jesus nika aiyatelikiheta natyo — nexa ihiyeha.
Hatyaoseta Jesus hiye ehareha, sábado xowaka haliti aiyatelikiheta hoka hatyo hiyeta ehareha ihiye, aisahene aokowiha.
Ehareha hoka Jesus nehena ihiyeha: — Baba atyo hakita kalikini kijiya hoka natyo tehitiya nahakita — nexa Jesus.

Hatyo iraetere hiyeta judeunai nityohalitiranai aisahene aokowiha. Maisa exaotyakisakahoha xema tyaonita sábado ferakenehena, exahe Enore Ityani aokowita. Exahe Enore hákakoanehare aokowita nikare iraeta hoka maisa waiyeta enomanaha. Hatyo xemere aisahene aokowiha.
Enore Ityani Atyo Iraiti Kakoare

Hatyaoseta Jesus nehena: — Xasemehena niraini. Enore Ityani taitaiya atyo hoka maisaiya atyo xoare hare tyomita. Hanexe Enore nómane waiyehena hoka hatyo akereta Ityani tyomita. Enexe tyomehena hotohare hoka enajikini maniya Ityani tehitiya tyomihitita Hanexe tyomitere akereta.
Enexe atyo awaitita Haisani hoka tyotya háomanenai hotikijita enomana. Hotikisaite exaheharexe Haisani ana hoka hatyoharenai ite Ityani tyomehena hoka xahakaharetyoaite.
— Hiyaiya, Enexe ekasekihetehena kamatinai hoka kasehenahititaha. Nikare tehitiya Ityani ekasekiheta aokowihenere kamati ekasekihitita.
Enexe maisa sema aokowita halitinai nómane tahi. Kasani Ityani sema halitinai nómane tahi hoka tyaonahiterene akereta mokahene aoka Enexe.
Kasani halitinai aiminisaha Ityani aokita Enexe kaxaiminisakitere akereta. Xala xamani atyo maisa aiminijita Ityani hoka maisa tehitiya atyo Enexe aiminisare. Hiyaiya, hatyo atyo axikatya Haisani.

— Aliterexe nomita xihiye, xala xamani atyo semaxemaita niraini hoka tyakekota tehitiya atyo noxaxikatyasehare hoka makamanehare atyo tyaona hoka maisaiya atyo kamawenekoaretyakita. Koxaka atyo hakamaneta kaseheta hoka menanehaliti tyaona.
Aliterexe nomita xihiye, enaose xane hikoahena, koxaka enaose xane hikoa. Maika ite kamatinai semehenaha Ityani xako. Semehenahaite hoka kasehetehenahitaha.
Enexe atyo tyaota menita hoka ihiyeta halitinae kaseta tyaonita. Haisani nikare tehitiya moka hoka Ityani hiyeta halitinai kaseta tyaonita.
Enexe iyateliti isa Haisani ana axalisa maheta halitinai hoka tyomahitere tahi sema hoka nikareta mokahene maheta. Hiyaiya, Haliti Ityani tehitiya atyo hoka.
— Awa atyo exeharenai hiyeta xahakaharetyoahena: ekakoitaite enaose xane hikoahena hoka tyotya kamatinai semehena Enore Ityani xako
hoka kamatinae kasehenahitehenaha haxawatyakalaha akota. Hatyaosetaite waiye tyomehenerenai atyoite menanehaliti tyaonaha hoka iniyalahare tyomehenerenai atyoite kaxawatyakehena — nexa Jesus.
Jesus Atyo Iraiti Kakoare

— Maisaiya atyo nowawiharenai hoka xoare hare notyomita. Baba niraine nasemita hoka nasemitere akereta namokita haliti. Tota maniya taita nahekoita halitinai kakoa hoka tyaonahitere akereta namokahitene. Baba Enore xaokalita nikare notyaonita, maisa noxaokalita xini.
— Nowawiya niraeta notahi hoka maisaiya xoare maheta xityakekota niraeni.
Xakore hoka hatya tehitiya atyo xakai notahi akiti. Hatyo iraihena hoka maisa atyo maoseraita xini.
Hiyaiya, xaxikatya haliti João ana axene maheta. Axahene hoka João xakai notahi akiti ihiyeha hoka maisa maoseratyahitene xini.
Maisaiya xoare maheta halitinai iraeha notahi nokatyakekotyaki maheta xakore hoka noxakaita exe iraiti waiyexe xihiye xikaiyakeheta maheta.
João atyo xaokanatyakalati. Takoa hoka aokanaitere akereta tyaonita halitinai koni, aotyakisahitene hoka. Maisa waha tyaonare xinekoni hoka exowaka xihalahare exaotyakira kakoa.

— João xakai notahi akiti halitinai hiye tyakekoha maheta natyo. Hoka exe tehitiya João xahehare nawaiye: maika notyomitere hiyeta xityakeko natyo. Baba axikatya natyo ehatene notyoma maheta. Maika xityakekohena natyo nománinai hiyeta.
— Noxaxikatyasehare Baba tehitiya irae notahi akiti, tyakeko natyo hoka. Hoka xiso atyo maisa xasemare exako, exahe xiyaiyarene.
Maisa iniraine tyaonita xikakoa. Xiyaiya, maisa natyo exaxikalahare xityakekota hoka.
— Babera Iraiti Waiyexe kakoare xakaixarita minita. Exema maniya xisaona hoka ximakamanehare xisaona xaokita hoka. Xakore hoka notahi atyo hatyo Iraiti Waiyexe nanekoa xairatyoare tyaonita.
Xakore atyo hoka maisa xisaona xaokowiye nokoamaniyi. Xisaonaiya nokoamaniyi hoka ximakamanehariya xisaona — nexa Jesus.
— Maisa atyo halitinai aeroretyaha natyo naokare.
Hiyaiya, notita atyo xiso, maisa atyo Enore xawaityare kaisere, maisa exema maniya xisaonare.
Baba niraine kakoare atyo natyo xakore hoka maisa xaokita natyo xomana. Hatyaiya kaoka xomana haxaokalita hoka xawaiyeteniya.
Komitainiya maisa aliyakere Enore xema maniya xisaonita. Kasani halitinai ihalahareha xikakoa xaokita, komita maisa Enore ihalahareta xikakoa xaokare.
— Xasemehena, maisaiya niraeharitita xiso Baba hiye. Xawaiyetita hatyo Moisés xaotyakira xakore hoka Moisés atyoite iraeharetya xiso.
Hiyaiya, Moisés xairatya notahi akiti. Xityakekoreya Moisés xaotyakira hoka xityakeko tehitiyaiya natyo.
Maisaiya xityakekota Moisés xairala hoka aliyakereya xityakekohena niraini? nexa Jesus ihiyeha.
